communication_goal: 核对运行环境与版本，再索取证据。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Make named learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI marks allowed. Scene: Two adult stick figures at a desk with an open laptop behind. Tester holds up a rectangular printed SCREENSHOT paper by its far side edge, fully front-facing near center right. Screenshot depicts browser window frame with top toolbar of three small circular icons, one large blank pane, a simple warning triangle. Developer points with open hand from left. Whole paper unobscured, no letters, version numerals or code.

coverage_review.scope: W054 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W054.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：两名同事核对问题环境，测试同事手持完整打印截图；浏览器窗口图示无文字，软件环境与版本由对白说明。截图纸张仅边缘被手握住，内容完整可裁剪。
